segments.sn17.4:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.4:1.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakagahanaṃ paviseyya.
segments.sn17.4:1.4: Sā tatra tatra sajjeyya, tatra tatra gayheyya [gaccheyya (sī.), gaṇheyya (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], tatra tatra bajjheyya, tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjeyya.
segments.sn17.4:1.5: ‘Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
segments.sn17.4:1.6: So tatra tatra sajjati, tatra tatra gayhati, tatra tatra bajjhati, tatra tatra anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn17.4:1.7: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban’”ti.

lines: Agamāsīti “ettha addhā kiñci khāditabbaṃ atthi, taṃ maccharāyanto maṃ esa nivāretī”ti saññāya agamāsi.

Papatāyāti papatā vuccati dīgharajjukabaddho ayakantakosake daṇḍakaṃ pavesetvā gahito kaṇṇikasallasaṇṭhāno, ayakaṇṭako, yasmiṃ vegena patitvā kaṭāhe laggamatte daṇḍako nikkhamati, rajjuko ekābaddho gacchateva.
Yena so kummoti udakasaddaṃ sutvā sāsaṅkaṭṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti nivattitvā yena so atthakāmo kummo.
Na dāni tvaṃ amhākanti idāni tvaṃ amittahatthaṃ gato, na amhākaṃ santakoti attho.
Evaṃ sallapantānaṃyeva ca nesaṃ nāvāya ṭhito luddo rajjukaṃ ākaḍḍhitvā kummaṃ gahetvā yathākāmaṃ akāsi.
159-160. Aṭṭhikacchapā vuccanti yesaṃ kapālamatthake tikhiṇā aṭṭhikoṭi hoti, tesaṃ samūho aṭṭhikacchapakulaṃ.
Macchakacchapādīnaṃ sarīre lambantī papatatīti papatā, vuccamānākāro ayakaṇṭako.
